glossary.definition: (1) "Applied behavior analysis" means the design, implementation, and evaluation of environmental modifications, using behavioral stimuli and consequences, to produce socially significant improvement in human behavior, including the use of direct observation, measurement, and functional analysis of the relationship between environment and behavior.
glossary.source_title: Section 1751.84 - Coverage for autism spectrum disorder.

glossary.definition: (2) "Autism spectrum disorder" means any of the pervasive developmental disorders or autism spectrum disorder as defined by the most recent edition of the diagnostic and statistical manual of mental disorders published by the American psychiatric association available at the time an individual is first evaluated for suspected developmental delay.
glossary.source_title: Section 1751.84 - Coverage for autism spectrum disorder.
Section 1751.84 - Coverage for autism spectrum disorder.

glossary.definition: (4) "Diagnosis of autism spectrum disorder" means medically necessary assessments, evaluations, or tests to diagnose whether an individual has an autism spectrum disorder.
glossary.source_title: Section 1751.84 - Coverage for autism spectrum disorder.

glossary.definition: (5) "Pharmacy care" means prescribed medications and any health-related services considered medically necessary to determine the need or effectiveness of the medications.
glossary.source_title: Section 1751.84 - Coverage for autism spectrum disorder.

glossary.definition: (6) "Psychiatric care" means direct or consultative services provided by a psychiatrist or psychiatric-mental health advanced practice registered nurse who is licensed in the state in which the psychiatrist or nurse practices.
glossary.source_title: Section 1751.84 - Coverage for autism spectrum disorder.

glossary.normalized: psychiatric-mental health advanced practice registered nurse
glossary.source_title: Section 1751.84 - Coverage for autism spectrum disorder.
glossary.term: Psychiatric-mental health advanced practice registered nurse

glossary.definition: (8) "Psychological care" means direct or consultative services provided by a psychologist licensed in the state in which the psychologist practices.
glossary.source_title: Section 1751.84 - Coverage for autism spectrum disorder.

glossary.definition: (9) "Therapeutic care" means services provided by a speech therapist, occupational therapist, or physical therapist licensed or certified in the state in which the person practices.
glossary.source_title: Section 1751.84 - Coverage for autism spectrum disorder.
